acceptanceCriteria: Decide accepts a reuse only from a record job that runs no repository code, needs every shard job and succeeded, read through the jobs API or log, failing closed otherwise
A test feeds a forged ci-tested-tree artifact and proves it is refused; the test fails against the current Decide
AFP-V0-024/046 amended with the trust argument; the .github change goes through the owner's ci-control-plane post
body: Found during the #1449 security fix (V1-2113, AFP-V0-163). tools/ci-reuse-plan/main.go Decide accepts ci-tested-tree-<tree>-full-<shard>-of-<shards> artifacts by name alone. The go-product-shard jobs that upload them also run repository tests, so code under test can upload a forged artifact naming a tree and cause a later run to skip its tests. AFP-V0-080 does not have the flaw: it reads only the jobs listing. Expected: reuse trusts only evidence produced by a job that runs no repository code (as the AFP-V0-163 fix does: a record job that needs every shard and prints the tree to its own log, read through the jobs API, failing closed). Actual: name-only trust. Version: origin/main 8def072.
title: ci: docs-plan reuse (AFP-V0-024/046) trusts ci-tested-tree artifacts by name alone; shard jobs that upload them run repository code
